name: Rebuild a whole page as code (Tailwind, React, HTML or Vue) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page as code
MiroMiro rebuilds every section of the page in a real browser: header, hero, features, pricing, footer...

You get **one file per section in a zip** (on **Zip the code**) and a link to **the whole page assembled** (on **Get the whole-page link**), with a Download HTML button.

In **Settings**, `output` is `tailwind`, `jsx` (React), `html` or `vue`. 25 credits per section; repeat calls within 24h are free.

**Setup (1 minute)**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open any MiroMiro node > Credential > Create new, paste the key.
3. Change the website in **Settings**, then click **Execute workflow**.
